cleansingStrength.counterSignal: CAPB and several conditioning routes buffer feel, so the call is strong because of the whole system rather than SLES alone.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: silicone gum, dimethicone, cationic guar and glycol distearate should provide noticeable slip, but the strong anti-dandruff cleansing chassis keeps care bounded.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: There are multiple substantive routes, but no clearly rich 2-in-1 or repair-care positioning.

weightPotential.counterSignal: The formula also contains TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate and problem-led/oily-scalp positioning, which raises reset capacity.

unresolvedFacts: Exact silicone/polymer deposition level cannot be proven from INCI order alone.
